notes.title: Update V1.0.4 Performance Optimization and Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Jack Is Missing has been updated to V1.0.4. The new update includes more optimization on performance, which allows a more smooth gameplay. The update also features changes to motion blur, because a lot of people did not like the heavy use of motion blur. Some reported bugs have also been fixed, including a bug that causes the player to skip over a big part of the game story plot.

notes.title: Release date delayed to 8/28
notes.notes: The release date for Jack Is Missing is changed from 8/22/2018 to 8/28/2018 due to app testing problems. Sorry for the delay, a 25% off launch discount will be applied as a result of this delay :)
